title: How to monetize web game
author: vide-coder
selftext:
I built this motion-based web game site over the last 2 months. move your head to throw flames, raise your eyebrows to throw bombs, and smile to activate overdrive.

So far it’s free. However, I want to monetize this with ads or sell it with a life time access. I thought it was a good concept, but so far I haven’t advertised it at all. Traffic is really low (average about 20 visitors). I have zero idea how to get some traction.

I also got rejected by Google AdSense twice with the reason “low value content,” even after fixing everything they mentioned.

Is it even possible to monetize this kind of idea/website?

comments.author: RuinousFate
comments.body:
You got this backwards. It has 20 visitors, part of which could be bots. You don't even know if people like your game. Basically, it is "low value content" as Google has said. Now, if its proven to have multiple players that play it and like it? Maybe have high retention? Then you can look into how to monetize it.

Don't worry, I fell into the same trap with my game. Thought of some form of monetization early on. Realized I was wasting time and it was too early for that and focused on feedback instead.

replies.author: vide-coder
replies.body: I started thinking if it was waste of my time. thanks for the feedback!

replies.author: RuinousFate
replies.body: I mean, do you want to play it? I don't expect to make money, I just want to make a game I want to play.

replies.author: vide-coder
replies.body: that’s a good point. I played it a lot so I wanted to get some feedback

comments.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
comments.body: This doesn't look like a game people would spend money on ngl.

replies.author: vide-coder
replies.body: I had to simplify the game to make it playable with motions. Yours is genuine feedback though. Thanks for checking!

replies.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
replies.body: I think there might also be some guides on the right way to monetise a game, try looking on youtube and reddit using those keywords
